fields.label: Shop name
fields.help: Shown at the top of the shop page, and on Mollie's payment page.

fields.label: Taking orders
fields.help: Off: the page shows the products but takes no orders.

fields.label: Payment
fields.help: request: you send a payment request yourself. mollie: customers pay online with your Mollie account (say: connect Mollie).

fields.label: Shipping cost
fields.help: In euro, like 4,95. Leave empty for free shipping.

fields.label: Free shipping from
fields.help: In euro, like 50. Leave empty to always charge shipping.

fields.label: Contact e-mail
fields.help: Shown to customers. A Dutch web shop has to show how to reach it.

fields.label: KvK number
fields.help: Shown at the bottom of the shop page, as Dutch law asks of a business.

fields.label: Business address
fields.help: Shown at the bottom of the shop page.

fields.label: Delivery and return terms
fields.help: Shown under every page: delivery time, the 14 days to return, how to return.
